images.caption: Figure 3:PCA visualization of latent representations.For the input images in (a), we visualize the top three principal components of normalized spatial latent features from (b) KL-VAE, (c) RobustAlign-VAE, (d) RobustRecon-VAE, and (e) RoAR-VAE. RobustAlign emphasizes object-level organization, RobustRecon preserves richer local variation, and RoAR combines both properties. PCA is fitted jointly across the four images for each tokenizer.
Figure 4:Qualitative comparison of text-to-image generation.Rows compare FLUX.1-VAE, VA-VAE, and RoAR-VAE tokenizers; each subject is shown after 32k and 120k downstream updates.
Figure 5:Image reconstruction visualization.Columns show the original image and reconstructions from baseline tokenizers and RoAR-VAE. Images are selected from TokBench(Wu et al., 2025).
